summary: Quiet inside day after Tuesday's selloff. Nasdaq closed flat at 29,143 and the S&P bounced to 7,668.75, both reclaiming above their falling stops but neither building a trend. Gold bounced 1.34 percent to 4,434 and crude held 90.63 above a rising stop. VIX fell almost 7 percent to 15.20 as fear cooled. A coiled, low volume tape drifting toward Friday's jobs report.
psychology: The danger on a slow inside day after a big move is boredom and revenge trading. A balance day with no clean signal is a day to size down or sit out, not to force a trade. Protect your capital and focus now so you can act with a clear head on Friday's jobs number.
